selected_session: exactly one current-cwd Session in process memory
rules: createCurrentCwd is the only startup path that creates a Session
resume requires an explicit id present in session.list
latestCurrentCwdSession returns the newest non-blank Session for canonical cwd
current-cwd Session options expose updatedAt and blank and are sorted updatedAt descending
resume fails closed on missing id, absent cwd, invalid cwd or cwd mismatch
resume never creates a replacement Session on failure
history tail is hydrated from the official session.history projection
live mux/host frames append only to the selected Session
event seq is the monotonic dedupe key; duplicates are ignored
sequence gaps and stream loss are explicit errors, never silent fallback
renderer never consumes this module; presentation receives typed decoded facts
no control metadata, sequence, health or endpoint fields enter Session payloads
